## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated, and `python -m unittest discover -s tests -t .` passes
- [ ] Frontend touched? `npm --prefix frontend run lint`, `test`, and `build` pass
- [ ] Stored formats or API changed? Ran `python scripts/check_contracts.py --update`, and explained the migration or reindex below
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, logs, or index files added (CI checks this; GitHub push protection should be on)
- [ ] TRD, decision log, or README updated if behavior changed
